source_documents.role: The verifier now separates packaged and non-packaged extension solution types and rejects packageRoots on the latter.
The focused suite now asserts one actionable rejection for configuration, profile-patch, and skill records.
The bilingual standard states that non-packaged solution types must omit packageRoots and packaged types must declare package roots.
The implemented Agent Note records the false-green cause, rejected alternatives, owner, and removal-safe consequences.

findings.summary: The verifier now rejects packageRoots on configuration, profile-patch, and skill records with a type-specific diagnostic while preserving packaged extension validation.
findings.limitations: The rule is governance validation; it does not inspect runtime package behavior.

findings.summary: The focused suite now covers all three non-packaged extension types and expects the actionable forbidden-packageRoots diagnostic for each.
findings.limitations: The full repository documentation aggregate remains a separate gate.

changes: Added an explicit non-packaged extension type set to the policy verifier.
Rejected packageRoots whenever configuration, profile-patch, or skill declares the field.
Added parameterized invalid fixtures for all three non-packaged solution types while retaining existing positive coverage.
Updated the bilingual improvement standard and added a paired implemented Agent Note.
Extended the existing governance policy owner to include the new Agent Note path.
unchanged: Packaged extension types still require non-empty packages/*/ roots.
No runtime package, profile, or released Session JSONL data changed.
No second policy owner was introduced for the verifier paths.

decision.result: AAA-016:A02 PASS — forbidden packageRoots rule and invalid fixtures implemented and verified
decision.diagnosis: The false-green policy path is closed at the owning verifier and focused test surfaces. Diagnostics identify the exact non-packaged solution type and the forbidden field.
decision.next_action: Complete AAA-016 and advance to the next independent task; retain the policy rule as part of the existing governance improvement.

commands: node --input-type=module -e probe configuration, profile-patch, and skill with packageRoots
